Portcast is a venture-backed, Singapore-based logistics technology startup helping freight forwarders turn data into better decisions and measurable business impact. Portcast uses AI to surface shipment exceptions, cost risks, and the right actions, helping teams focus on the shipments that need their attention, keep freight costs under control, and make procurement decisions with confidence. Our vision is to be the AI data and intelligence layer that powers exception management and margin improvement on every shipment.

Founded in 2018 and backed by leading technology investors, we are a lean, globally distributed team building technology for an industry going through a major digital transformation.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Youll be the person accountable for the delivery state of our product initiatives once they move into execution. Youll report directly to our Senior Product Manager and make sure ownership is clear across Engineering, Data, and Solutions, work is progressing as expected, dependencies are being managed, and risks are surfaced early rather than when they become launch problems.

Were looking for someone who understands our product, technology, and data well enough to follow the work, understand why were building something, spot when execution is drifting from the intended outcome, and know when to bring an issue back to Product for clarification.

This is a hands-on IC role and youll be the first person in this role at Portcast, giving you the opportunity to shape how we manage and deliver product initiatives as we scale. This role requires daily working-hour overlap with our Asia-based Tech Team.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE IN THIS ROLE

  • No launch delays, cleaner releases, and shorter cycle times, driven by earlier identification of risks, dependencies, and blockers, better coordination across Product, Engineering, Data, and Solutions, and clearer visibility into what is moving, what is blocked, and what needs attention.

WHAT YOU LL OWN

  • Own delivery from kickoff to release: Take ownership of the operational delivery state once a product initiative moves into execution. Make sure ownership is clear, work starts when expected, progress is visible, and initiatives continue moving through development, testing, and release.

  • Track dependencies and surface risks early: Monitor cross-functional dependencies, blockers, competing priorities, scope changes, and potential delays.

  • Coordinate across Product, Engineering, Data, and Solutions: Make sure teams know who owns what, dependencies are understood, and the right people have the context they need. Act as the central point of coordination so Product has a clear view of delivery.

  • Coordinate handover and launch readiness: Help coordinate the handover between Engineering, Data, Solutions, and Product so that the relevant teams have what they need for testing and acceptance.

  • Keep execution aligned with product intent: Understand the goals and key requirements behind an initiative well enough to spot when implementation appears to diverge from what was intended. Surface questions, gaps, or inconsistencies early and bring them back to Product for clarification before they become testing or release issues.

  • Maintain a clear source of truth: Keep tickets, timelines, project status, dependencies, key decisions, and risks up to date so that the team can quickly understand what is moving, what is blocked, and where attention is needed.

  • Keep delivery moving without creating bureaucracy: Bring structure, follow-through, and accountability to the delivery process without adding unnecessary processes. Join relevant standups and working sessions so you can identify issues and resolve them quickly.

WHAT WE RE LOOKING FOR

  • Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.

  • At least 3+ years in project management, program management, delivery, product operations, or a similar role.

  • A proven ability to close things and keep initiatives moving: Experience managing projects or initiatives involving multiple technical and cross-functional teams in a startup or B2B SaaS environment, ideally in data-heavy domains, and even better in logistics tech or supply chain tech.

  • Understands data and strong technical foundation. You can read code, understand how systems and data pipelines fit together, and dig into the work alongside engineers and data scientists. You know the difference between a real blocker and noise.

  • Strong execution instincts: You naturally keep track of the details that others might miss. You chase loose ends, surface blockers, follow up on dependencies, and make sure decisions actually turn into action.

  • First-principles problem solving: When something is stuck or going off track, you understand why rather than simply following the existing process. You work out what needs to change and involve the right people to resolve it.

  • Comfort with ambiguity: You can create clarity when the requirements, ownership, or process arent fully defined. You are comfortable making progress without having every answer upfront.

  • Strong cross-functional communication: You can translate between Product, Engineering, Data, and customer-facing teams. You know what different teams need to know, communicate clearly, and escalate issues early without creating unnecessary noise.

  • High ownership: You dont see your job as simply tracking whether someone completed a task. You take responsibility for the overall delivery state and stay on an issue until it is actually resolved.

  • Startup mindset: You enjoy working in a lean environment where there isnt a dedicated person for every function. Youre willing to get into the details, solve problems yourself, and build lightweight processes when they are genuinely useful.

WHAT S IN IT FOR YOU

  • Own a high-leverage problem: Youll be the person responsible for keeping delivery moving across teams, directly influencing how quickly and reliably we turn product ideas into something customers can use.

  • Work at the intersection of Product, AI, Data, and Logistics: Our products combine software, data, machine learning, and deep logistics expertise. Youll get exposure to complex product problems where the challenge isnt simply building software, but making sure data, models, workflows, and customer needs come together.

  • Real impact from day one: we re lean by design so youll have a high degree of ownership. There is no large PMO or layer of project managers around you. Youll need to be comfortable getting into the details, figuring things out independently, and knowing when something needs to be pushed, clarified, escalated, or simply solved.

  • Globally distributed, remote-first flexibility: work with a fully distributed team across Asia and Europe, built on trust, accountability, and collaboration.

OUR CORE VALUES GUIDE EVERYTHING WE DO

  • Curiosity: We dig into why somethings slipping, not just how to patch it. We stay close to the work and the data.

  • Ownership: We act like founders. We hold a project together end to end and stay on it until it ships cleanly.

jobDescription:
About Us:


Our purpose is to help clients exceed their financial health goals. Across the reimbursement cycle, our scalable solutions and clinical expertise help solve programmatic needs. Enabling our teams with leading technology allows analytics to guide our solutions and keeps us accountable achieving goals.


We build long-term careers by investing in YOU. We seek to create an environment that cultivates your professional development and personal growth, as we believe your success is our success.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
Note: The essential duties and responsibilities below are intended to describe the general duties and responsibilities of this position and are not intended to be an exhaustive statement of duties. This position may perform all or most of the primary duties listed below. Specific tasks, responsibilities or competencies may be documented in the Team Member s performance objectives as outlined by the Team Member s immediate Leadership Team Member.

About the Role

We are looking for an AI Engineer with a strong focus on Large Language Models (LLMs) and Generative AI to design, build, and deploy intelligent, LLM-powered systems. Youll work on prompt engineering, RAG pipelines, agentic workflows, and fine-tuning, while building robust backend services in Java and Python - with React front-end knowledge as a plus to help ship end-to-end AI features.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design, build, and deploy LLM-powered applications - chatbots, copilots, agents, RAG systems, and summarization/extraction pipelines
  • Develop and optimize prompt engineering strategies (few-shot, chain-of-thought, structured output, function/tool calling) for production use cases
  • Build and maintain Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines - embeddings, chunking strategies, vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS, pgvector)
  • Fine-tune and evaluate LLMs (open-source and closed-source) using techniques like LoRA/QLoRA, instruction tuning, and RLHF where applicable
  • Design and implement agentic workflows using frameworks like LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or custom orchestration
  • Build backend services and APIs in Java and/or Python to serve LLM applications at scale
  • Implement evaluation frameworks for LLM outputs - accuracy, hallucination rate, latency, cost, and safety metrics
  • Manage prompt versioning, model routing, and caching for cost/performance optimization across multiple LLM providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-source models)
  • Collaborate with front-end developers (or contribute directly in React) to surface LLM features in user-facing products
  • Monitor deployed LLM systems for drift, degradation, and safety/guardrail violations; iterate on mitigation strategies
  • Implement guardrails, content filtering, and responsible AI practices (bias mitigation, prompt injection defense, data privacy)
  • Stay current with the fast-moving LLM/GenAI landscape (new models, techniques, tooling) and assess applicability to the business
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or related field (or equivalent practical experience)
  • Strong programming skills in Java and Python
  • Hands-on experience with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Gemini, etc.) and open-source LLMs (Llama, Mistral, etc.)
  • Practical experience with prompt engineering and RAG architecture
  • Experience with vector databases and embedding models
  • Familiarity with LLM orchestration frameworks: LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, or similar
  • Solid understanding of transformer architecture and how LLMs work under the hood
  • Experience building and consuming REST/gRPC APIs for AI-serving backends
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes)
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience fine-tuning LLMs (LoRA, QLoRA, PEFT) and working with Hugging Face Transformers
  • Experience designing multi-agent systems or tool-using/agentic AI workflows
  • Familiarity with LLM evaluation tools (RAGAS, DeepEval, promptfoo, human-in-the-loop eval pipelines)
  • Working knowledge of React to build or collaborate on UI components for LLM-driven features (chat interfaces, streaming responses, etc.)
  • Understanding of guardrails/safety tooling (Guardrails AI, NeMo Guardrails, content moderation APIs)
  • Experience with MLOps/LLMOps practices - CI/CD, model/prompt versioning, observability (LangSmith, Weights Biases, Arize)
  • Background in NLP or contributions to open-source LLM/GenAI projects
Soft Skills
  • Curiosity and adaptability - comfortable navigating a fast-evolving space where best practices shift monthly
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking
  • Ability to communicate technical AI concepts to non-technical stakeholders
  • Collaborative mindset and eagerness to mentor/learn from peers

Regular eye-hand coordination and manual dexterity is required to operate office equipment. The ability to perform work at a computer terminal for 6-8 hours a day and function in an environment with constant interruptions is required. This is a hands-on IC role. You will be in the code daily - architecting agent pipelines, building MCP servers, designing RAG systems, managing LLM costs at scale, and iterating with real users and clients. If you are looking for a role where you can lead a large team without building yourself, this is not it. If you want to own a full agentic system from design to production, this is exactly it.

Job Title

Network Operations Engineer

Job Summary

Were looking for a Network Operations Engineer to join our CloudOps team and keep our infrastructure secure, patched, and available around the clock. Youll monitor and support a multi-cloud environment, primarily Azure, with an AWS footprint, spanning Windows, Linux, and SQL Server systems. Coverage runs follow-the-sun, so youll be part of a rotation that ensures alerts never go unwatched, wherever in the world they fire.

What You'll Do

  • Monitor infrastructure health, performance, and security across Azure, AWS, Windows, Linux, and SQL Server using our monitoring and observability tools.
  • Triage incoming alerts, assess severity, and take action - or escalate with clear context - as part of a follow-the-sun on-call rotation.
  • Diagnose and resolve incidents using established runbooks, and document what happened, why, and how it was fixed.
  • Plan, schedule, and execute patches and updates across cloud resources, servers, and databases, coordinating maintenance windows to minimize business impact.
  • Keep patch and compliance records current to meet security and regulatory requirements.
  • Track SLA, MTTR, and MTBF metrics, and report on system reliability to stakeholders.
  • Contribute to post-incident reviews and refine runbooks, alert thresholds, and escalation policies based on what you learn.
  • Flag opportunities to automate repetitive operational work.

What You Bring

  • 2-4 years in cloud operations, systems administration, or network operations.
  • Hands-on experience with Azure; exposure to AWS is a plus.
  • Comfort administering both Windows and Linux systems, plus familiarity with SQL Server.
  • Experience with monitoring/alerting tools (e.g., Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, or equivalent) and patch management processes.
  • A track record of clear incident documentation and communication under pressure.
  • Willingness to work a follow-the-sun on-call rotation, including off-hours coverage.

Nice to Have

  • Azure certifications (AZ-104, AZ-900) or AWS equivalents.
  • Scripting experience (PowerShell, Python, or Bash) for automation.
  • Familiarity with Infrastructure-as-Code (Bicep, Terraform, ARM) or CI/CD pipelines.
  • Background in SRE practices or backup/disaster recovery (RTO/RPO).

Design, build and operate the Python/FastAPI services that extract entities and relationships from unstructured documents, resolve them to canonical identifiers, maintain the knowledge graph, and serve graph-augmented retrieval alongside vector search for multi-hop and relational questions.

Responsibilities

  • Build entity and relation extraction services over unstructured documents molecules, brands, indications, therapeutic areas, endpoints, claims.
  • Build entity resolution: alias handling, blocking and candidate generation, fuzzy and embedding matching, calibrated thresholds, human review routing.
  • Design and maintain the graph schema and ontology; incremental ingest, node and edge deduplication and merging, provenance on every edge.
  • Fuse graph and vector results into a single ranked, cited context for the retrieval service.
  • Instrument, monitor and support the services in production.

Qualifications

  • 5–9 years software engineering, with demonstrable knowledge-graph construction and applied NLP delivered to production.
  • Has built a knowledge graph from unstructured text — not queried an existing one, and not a CRUD application on a graph database.
  • Graph at production scale. Millions of nodes and edges; incremental updates with stable node identity; supernode and traversal-explosion handling with bounded depth and timeouts.
  • Entity resolution at corpus scale. Blocking and candidate generation that avoid O(n) comparison, with measured precision on a labelled sample.
  • Graph database in production. Neo4j, Amazon Neptune or equivalent; Cypher / openCypher fluency.
  • Ontology and taxonomy modelling. Schema evolution without breaking downstream consumers; judgement on node vs. edge vs. property.
  • Extraction. NER and relation extraction — LLM-based, model-based (spaCy, scispaCy, transformers) or hybrid, with the judgement to choose.
  • Graph vs. vector judgement. Knows where graph retrieval wins — multi-hop, relational, comparative and aggregate questions — and that hybrid is the production norm.

Biomedical ontologies and registries: UMLS, MeSH, SNOMED, RxNorm, ICD-10, DrugBank, ChEMBL.

Senior RAG - Document AI Engineer

Design, build and operate the Python/FastAPI microservices that turn heterogeneous enterprise documents into accurate, cited answers from document parsing and chunking through enrichment, hybrid retrieval and evaluation. You own retrieval quality and the evidence for it.

Responsibilities

  • Build document processing services: format-aware parsing across native text, OCR and vision-language models; table and figure extraction.
  • Build a configurable chunking service with strategies selectable per document class, maintained as versioned pipeline profiles.
  • Implement LLM-based metadata extraction into strict JSON schemas, with confidence scoring and human-in-the-loop review.
  • Build the retrieval service: query rewriting, hybrid dense + BM25 with rank fusion, metadata pre-filtering, cross-encoder reranking, context assembly with citations.
  • Own the evaluation harness — golden Q&A sets, recall@k, nDCG/MRR, groundedness — and gate releases on measured quality.
  • Instrument, monitor and support the services in production.

Qualifications

  • 6–10 years software engineering, with 2+ years building retrieval or document-AI systems used by real users in production.
  • Production RAG at scale. 100k+ documents and millions of chunks; p95 query latency under 2s, sustained under concurrent load.
  • Operational maturity. Incremental and delta ingest; has re-indexed a live corpus without downtime after a chunking or embedding-model change.
  • Chunking as a measured design decision. Hierarchical parent–child and section-aware strategies — not a single global token size.
  • Retrieval depth. Hybrid dense + sparse (BM25) retrieval and rank fusion; cross-encoder reranking; embedding model selection and evaluation.
  • Retrieval evaluation in practice. Recall@k, nDCG/MRR and a groundedness measure, used to justify changes.
  • Document processing. Messy real-world PDF, PPTX and DOCX; OCR pipelines and their failure modes; vision-language models for charts and infographics.
  • Python and FastAPI in production. Python 3.11+, async, Pydantic, streaming/SSE, OpenAPI contracts, API versioning.
  • Service engineering. Queue and worker patterns, idempotency, retries, dead-letter handling; Docker, pytest, Git and CI; structured logging and tracing.
  • AWS as a consumer. S3, ECS/EKS, Lambda, Bedrock, Textract, OpenSearch; a vector database in production with collection design and metadata filtering.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Life sciences, pharma or other regulated content; PII/PHI handling.
  • Multimodal retrieval; MCP or agent tool surfaces.
  • Judgement on frameworks — has used LangChain or LlamaIndex and can say when not to.

About Us

Innovative thinking, delivery excellence and thought leadership to help our clients transform their business. Together with our clients and industry partners, we deliver disruptive work that is changing energy and financial services.

#BEYOURSELFATWORK

Capco has a tolerant, open culture that values diversity, inclusivity, and creativity.

CAREER ADVANCEMENT

With no forced hierarchy at Capco, everyone has the opportunity to grow as we grow, taking their career into their own hands.

DIVERSITY & INCLUSION

We believe that diversity of people and perspective gives us a competitive advantage.

Job Description

We are looking for a hands-on Senior AI / GenAI Engineer who combines strong Python engineering skills with practical experience building production-oriented RAG and Agentic AI solutions.

This is a builder role for an independent, self-driven engineer who can take ownership of a problem, understand the underlying business objective and cost implications, define a sensible technical approach, and drive the solution through implementation without requiring continuous direction.

Core Requirements

Python Engineering

  • Strong hands-on Python programmingskills with a sound understanding of OOP and software engineering principles.
  • Ability to write clean, modular, maintainable and production-quality code.
  • Experience developing APIs using Python frameworks; FastAPI is preferred.

RAG

  • Hands-on experience implementing an end-to-end RAG pipeline, covering data ingestion, retrieval, context preparation and response generation.
  • Practical experience with retrieval techniques such as:
    • Hybrid search/retrieval
    • Reranking
    • Query rewriting
  • Exposure to advanced RAG approaches such as Agentic RAG, Corrective RAG and HyDE.
  • Understanding of RAG/LLM response evaluation, preferably using frameworks such as RAGAS or TruLens.

Agentic AI

  • Hands-on experience building agent-based AI workflowsusing an orchestration framework, preferably LangGraph or equivalent.
  • Strong understanding of agent workflow design, including nodes, edges, state management and orchestration.
  • Experience integrating LLMs with tools/tool calling.
  • Understanding or implementation experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol).

Graph Databases

  • Practical hands-on experience with a graph database, such as Neo4j or equivalent.

Azure / Cloud

  • Hands-on cloud implementation experience; Azure is preferred.
  • Relevant experience may include:
    • Azure AI Search
    • Azure Cosmos DB
    • Azure AI Document Intelligence
    • Azure AI Foundry
    • Azure Application Insights

Added Advantage

Exposure to data engineering technologies such as:

  • Apache Airflow
  • PySpark
  • Azure Data Factory

What We Specifically Look For

We are looking for someone with strong engineering ownership who can independently initiate and drive work rather than wait for detailed instructions.

The candidate should be able to:

  • Understand the business problem and objectivebehind a technical requirement.
  • Consider cost, budget and operational implicationswhen making engineering decisions.
  • Independently structure the technical approach and drive implementation.
  • Challenge or improve existing approaches when there is a better solution.
  • Demonstrate strong coding and problem-solving ability, not just theoretical GenAI knowledge.
  • Show genuine passion for engineering and AI, with evidence of personally building, experimenting and solving real-world problems.

This is not a purely theoretical or prompt-engineering role. We are looking for a strong programmer and hands-on AI engineer who can take GenAI solutions from problem definition through implementation and connect the technology to measurable business needs.

If you are keen to join us, you will be part of an organization that values your contributions, recognizes your potential, and provides ample opportunities for growth. For more information, visit www.capco.com. Follow us on Twitter, Facebook, LinkedIn, and YouTube.

title: Ai Ml Engineer
jobDescription:
We are looking for a dynamic and innovative AI/ML Engineer with expertise in Generative AI and hands-on experience in GCP or other cloud platforms. The ideal candidate will have proven experience in developing, training, fine-tuning, and deploying advanced AI/ML models. You will play a pivotal role in building scalable, production-ready solutions involving large datasets, NLP techniques, and cutting-edge frameworks such as MCP, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and REACT (Retrieve, Extract, Adapt, Construct, Think).

This role requires a solid foundation in Python, SQL, and AI/ML development pipelines, combined with a passion for solving real-world problems using AI.

Roles & Responsibilities

  1. Model Development & Training
    • Design, train, and fine-tune AI/ML models, especially Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs), to address specific use cases.
    • Build conversational AI solutions and chatbots using frameworks such as LangChain, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), and Chain-of-Thought (COT) prompting.
    • Apply advanced techniques, including embeddings, fine-tuning, and custom prompting strategies.
    • Incorporate REACT (Retrieve, Extract, Adapt, Construct, Think) methods to enhance model capabilities.
    • Develop scalable AI solutions to integrate seamlessly into production environments.
  2. Data Handling
    • Manage large-scale datasets for AI/ML applications, ensuring data quality, transformation, and normalization.
    • Conduct data analysis, preprocessing, and munging to extract valuable insights.
    • Implement scalable data engineering workflows for model development and production.
  3. Cloud AI/ML Deployment
    • Deploy, manage, and optimize AI models on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) (or other cloud platforms like AWS/Azure).
    • Leverage GCP services such as Vertex AI, BigQuery, Cloud Functions, and Dataflow for AI workflows.
  4. Collaboration & Solutioning
    • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including product managers, data scientists, and software engineers, to deliver AI-driven solutions.
    • Integrate models with client-facing applications, ensuring end-to-end implementation.
    • Support scalable development through Docker for containerization (a plus).
  5. Continuous Improvement
    • Stay updated with the latest advancements in AI, ML, and Generative AI frameworks, tools, and methodologies.
    • Proactively learn new technologies and apply them to improve processes and solutions.
  6. Web Scraping (Optional but Preferred)
    • Implement web scraping solutions to gather data from unstructured sources for model training and validation.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • 3-8 years of experience in AI/ML model development, training, and fine-tuning.
  • Strong programming skills in Python and SQL.
  • Hands-on experience with Generative AI, LLMs, and NLP techniques.
  • Experience working with LangChain, RAG frameworks, and advanced prompting strategies.
  • Proficiency in Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting, Model Context Protocol (MCP), and Agent-to-Agent (A2A) orchestration
  • Proficiency in embeddings and fine-tuning models for specific tasks.
  • Strong understanding of machine learning algorithms and statistical analysis.
  • Experience working with large datasets and scalable data processing workflows.
  • Hands-on experience with GCP (Vertex AI, BigQuery) or other cloud platforms (AWS/Azure).
  • Knowledge of Docker for deployment and containerization.
  • Solid skills in data cleaning, transformation, and normalization for data integrity.

Preferred Skills

  • Familiarity with Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF).
  • Understanding of COT (Chain-of-Thought) prompting.
  • Proficiency in REACT (Retrieve, Extract, Adapt, Construct, Think) frameworks.
  • Experience in web scraping techniques.

Key Attributes

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in a team environment.
  • Excellent communication skills to interact with stakeholders and cross-functional teams.
  • Proactive attitude to learn and adopt new AI technologies and frameworks.

Why Join Us?

  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI/ML solutions.
  • Collaborative and innovative work culture.
  • Access to state-of-the-art tools, frameworks, and GCP resources.
  • Growth opportunities with a focus on professional development in AI/ML.Role & responsibilities

descriptionFromApi:
Position Overview: Randstad Digital is building an agentic framework a Salesforce-native, multi-agent AI platform: an orchestrator “brain” coordinating Agentforce specialists, LLM engines and deterministic Apex skills across channels (in-org voice assistant, Google Chat, mobile). We are seeking a Salesforce AI Platform Engineer with 4+ years of experience to help build the platform itself — not configuration, not release management — working in an AI-first model, pairing daily with Claude-based engineering agents alongside our IT Director and engineers.

Key Responsibilities:
• Platform Engineering (Apex): Design and extend orchestration layers — planner loops, deterministic intent routing, circuit breakers, audit trails, session continuity — with rigorous callout/DML ordering and a test-first discipline.
• LLM Integration: Build against Anthropic Claude and Google Gemini APIs and more — tool-use loops, system-prompt engineering, structured outputs and fallback chains; own the quality and latency of AI answers.
• Agentforce: Create and maintain agents via the Agent API and GenAI metadata (planner bundles, topics, plugins); navigate platform quirks and compile behaviours.
• Channel Engineering: Evolve channel agents — Google Chat app (Cards v2, dialogs, slash commands, service-account OAuth), Cloudflare Worker relays, and future Teams/Slack surfaces.
• Front-End (LWC): Build polished, branded assistant UIs — utility-bar voice assistant, orchestrator console dashboards — with Lightning Web Security-aware patterns.
• AI-Assisted Delivery: Drive Claude Code engineering sessions, review AI-authored code critically, and keep specs and handoff documents current so multiple AI-assisted engineers work concurrently without collisions.
• Integration Plumbing: Named/External Credentials, External Client Apps, OAuth 2.0 flows (client credentials, JWT bearer) and inbound REST webhooks with JWT verification.





Technical Skills & Qualifications:
Required:
• 4+ years of Salesforce platform development: advanced Apex (async patterns, callouts, dynamic SOQL, USER_MODE security), LWC, Metadata API and SFDX-based deployments.
• Hands-on LLM API integration experience (Anthropic, OpenAI or Google Gemini) — tool/function calling, prompt engineering, multi-turn state management.
• Solid JavaScript/TypeScript and Node.js; comfort with serverless edges (Cloudflare Workers or similar).
• Demonstrated fluency working WITH AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor) as a force multiplier — you review, verify and direct; you never paste blindly.
• OAuth 2.0 depth: client credentials, JWT bearer, service accounts, token lifecycle.
• Strong written communication — specs, handoffs and decision logs are how this team scales.
• Agile self-starter comfortable with high autonomy and rapid shipping from sandbox to UAT to production.
Nice to have:
• Certifications: Salesforce Platform Developer II • Salesforce AI Specialist / Agentforce Specialist • Salesforce JavaScript Developer I.
• Google Workspace app development (Chat apps, Cards v2, service accounts).
• Voice interfaces: TTS/STT integration (ElevenLabs, Web Speech API).
• React Native (mobile companion app).
• Security frameworks (OWASP SAMM, ISO 27001)

Technology & Practice Innovation | Taxpert Professionals Private Limited

Compensation- Commensurate with experience and qualifications; to be discussed at interview


ABOUT TAXPERT PROFESSIONALS

Taxpert Professionals Private Limited is an India-based advisory and consulting firm led by a team of Chartered Accountants and Company Secretaries with over two decades of experience. The firm advises clients listed on the NSE, BSE, and US/UK stock exchanges across the pharmaceutical, IT/ITES, manufacturing, shipping, media, and banking & financial services sectors, on Income Tax, GST, Customs, FEMA, Foreign Trade Policy, and Companies Act matters.

As the firm scales its advisory delivery, we are investing in Artificial Intelligence agents and automation to enhance research, compliance, and client-service capabilities across our practice.


ROLE OVERVIEW

We are seeking an AI Solutions Consultant to design, build, and implement AI agents that support the firm's tax, regulatory, and compliance advisory functions. The ideal candidate combines hands-on technical capability in building AI/LLM-based agents with a working understanding of how consulting and professional-services firms operate – client engagements, research workflows, documentation standards, and confidentiality requirements.

This is a client-facing and internally transformative role, requiring the candidate to work closely with the firm's Directors and small team to translate advisory workflows into automated, AI-enabled solutions.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Design, develop, and deploy AI agents (LLM-based, agentic workflows, RAG pipelines) to automate and augment tax research, drafting, compliance tracking, and client advisory processes.

Identify high-impact automation opportunities across the firm's service lines (Income Tax, GST, Customs, FEMA, FTP, Companies Act, SEBI) in consultation with subject-matter partners.

Integrate AI agents with the firm's existing tools and data sources (document repositories, MIS workbooks, email, and practice-management systems), ensuring outputs meet professional accuracy and confidentiality standards.

Build agent architectures using modern frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, agentic orchestration tools) and appropriate LLM APIs, with proper guardrails, prompt engineering, and evaluation pipelines.

Establish quality-control and human-in-the-loop review protocols so that AI-generated outputs are verified against authoritative sources (statutes, rules, circulars, notifications) before client delivery.

Ensure all implementations comply with applicable data-privacy and confidentiality obligations, including client data handling under the DPDP Act, 2023, and internal information-security policies.

Prepare clear documentation, SOPs, and internal training material so that partners and staff can adopt and operate AI-enabled workflows independently.

Track emerging developments in enterprise AI/agentic technology relevant to the professional-services and consulting industry, and recommend tools, vendors, or platforms to the Directors.

Support client-facing engagements where AI/automation forms part of the deliverable (e.g., AI governance advisory, DPDP Act implementation projects, digital transformation mandates).


REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.

3–6 years of overall experience, including demonstrable prior experience within a consulting, professional-services, or advisory firm environment (Big 4, mid-tier CA/CS firms, management consulting, or technology consulting).

Proven, hands-on experience designing and deploying AI agents or agentic workflows (not limited to prompt-based chatbots) – including at least one production or client-facing implementation.

Working proficiency with Python and common AI/ML tooling; practical experience with LLM orchestration frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, or comparable agent frameworks.

Understanding of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector databases, prompt engineering, and evaluation/guardrail techniques for enterprise AI deployments.

Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical AI concepts for partners, clients, and non-technical stakeholders.


PREFERRED SKILLS & ATTRIBUTES

– Prior exposure to the tax, audit, legal, or financial-advisory domain, or to compliance-heavy, document-intensive workflows.

– Familiarity with data-privacy frameworks applicable in India (DPDP Act, 2023) and enterprise information-security practices.

– Experience with Microsoft Office automation, VBA/macros, or low-code/no-code automation platforms is an added advantage.

– Exposure to cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, or GCP) and API-based integrations.

– A consulting mindset – client-orientation, attention to detail, comfort with ambiguity, and ownership of deliverables under professional deadlines.

– High standards of integrity and discretion, given exposure to confidential client and financial information.


WHAT WE OFFER

An opportunity to build and own the AI/automation charter for a well-established, growth-stage professional-services firm serving marquee listed clients.

Direct mentorship and working exposure to the firm's Directors and senior domain experts across international tax, FEMA, and regulatory advisory.

A collaborative, hybrid working environment based in Mumbai, with the scope to shape how AI is adopted across the firm's service lines.


HOW TO APPLY

Interested candidates may submit their updated resume on sneha@taxpertpro.com, along with a brief note on any AI agent(s) they have built or implemented (including scope, tools used, and outcome), to Taxpert Professionals Private Limited.   • Knowledge-Based Resolution: Utilize internal knowledge repositories, SOPs, and operational documentation to maximize first-touch resolution while continuously expanding personal expertise.
  • Case Quality & Documentation: Create clear, concise, and comprehensive case documentation that enables efficient collaboration with downstream resolver groups - any resolver should be able to pick up the ticket and execute without follow-up questions.
  • Cross-Regional Collaboration: Partner effectively with resolver teams and stakeholders across multiple regions to drive timely resolutions and improve operational performance.

Core Competencies

  • Critical Thinking: Analyzes complex situations using structured reasoning; evaluates multiple sources of information; identifies underlying causes and develops logical, well-supported solutions.
  • Written Communication: Produces clear, concise, professional, and customer-friendly written communication easily understood across global audiences.
  • Ownership: Assumes complete accountability for customer outcomes by proactively driving cases to resolution.
  • Bias for Action: Acts decisively with available information while balancing customer experience, operational risk, and business priorities.
  • Judgment & Decision Making: Exercises sound decision making regarding issue prioritization, escalation paths, and resolution strategies - including under ambiguity.
  • Customer Obsession: Consistently seeks to reduce customer effort, improve transparency, and deliver excellent support experiences.
  • Attention to Detail: Maintains accuracy in case documentation, diagnostics, routing, and follow-up while managing multiple priorities simultaneously.

Basic Qualifications

  • Minimum 4 years of experience in Ticket Support, Service Desk, Employee Support, Workplace Support, Contact Center Operations, IT Support, or similar operational support environments
  • Experience working within high-volume, SLA-driven support organizations in global or multi-regional environments
  • Demonstrated experience working in complex, multi-stakeholder customer cases from intake through verified resolution, comfortable working across multiple systems simultaneously
  • Exceptional written and verbal English communication skills - professional, precise, and actionable; additional language proficiency is a plus
  • Strong prioritization skills with the ability to manage high volumes without quality degradation with critical thinking and analytical capability
  • Experience with ticketing platforms and case management systems and strong proficiency using knowledge management tools and operational documentation

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting Global Workplace Support or Corporate Real Estate operations
  • Experience coordinating with external vendors and service providers for issue resolution
  • Experience using AI-assisted support tools and automation platforms

Performance Expectations

  • Independently investigate and resolve support requests with minimal supervision
  • Produce quality case documentation that enables efficient downstream execution with minimal rework
  • Exercise sound judgment when balancing resolution versus escalation
  • Leverage knowledge repositories effectively to maximize first-touch resolution
  • Deliver outstanding customer experiences while consistently meeting/exceeding SLA commitments

Scheduled Weekly Hours: 48

Prepare cost analyses and variance reports for management review. Recommend process improvements to enhance operational efficiency and reduce costs.

Conduct performance evaluations and support professional development of team members. Foster a collaborative team environment focused on service excellence.

Education

Bachelors degree in Facility Management, Business Administration, Hospitality Management, or related field. Professional certifications such as IFMA (International Facility Management Association) or CAFM (Certified Associate Facility Manager) are advantageous.

Experience

Minimum 3-5 years of experience in facility management with focus on soft services operations. Proven track record of managing multiple vendors and service contracts. Experience in commercial real estate, corporate facilities, or property management preferred. Demonstrated experience in client-facing roles and stakeholder management.

Technical Skills

Strong understanding of soft services operations including housekeeping, security, catering, and pest control. Proficiency in facility management software and computerized maintenance management systems (CMMS). Knowledge of health, safety, and environmental regulations applicable to facility operations. Competency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook).

Core Competencies

  • Excellent organizational and multitasking abilities with strong attention to detail.
  • Effective communication skills, both written and verbal, for interaction with clients, vendors, and team members.

  • Strong negotiation and vendor management capabilities.
  • Customer service orientation with focus on delivering quality results.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

This position requires regular site visits and inspections across assigned facilities. Flexibility to respond to facility emergencies outside regular business hours may be required. Physical ability to walk facilities, climb stairs, and conduct site inspections as needed.

jobDescription:
Job Summary

The Commercial function exists to support the sustainable growth of Work Dynamics, with stronger profit margins. The key levers to achieve this are securing more income for the valuable scope we deliver, cross-selling higher margin products, driving productivity, finding ways to benefit from our scale and changing our commercial contract models and pricing.

The Commercial Analyst is an essential role on the team. Working closely with regional and global Commercial, Finance, Operations, Transition, Sourcing and Account team members enabling Work Dynamics accounts to develop budgets, drive and measure cost savings and improve profit margins for the firm. It will require strong financial acumen, commercial knowledge, high levels of analytical and communication skills and attention to detail.

The Commercial Delivery Analyst will work closely with the Commercial Delivery team, and a cross-functional team of resources to carry out Commercial Due Diligence and Commercial Resilience programs for new and expanding client accounts. Commercial Due Diligence includes the review and categorization of client spend data to validate financial baselines and identify cost savings and efficiencies. Commercial Resilience includes Contract Training and general commercial support during the stabilisation stage for the Account.

Responsibilities

  • Review the Master Services Agreement and provide support in preparing Contract Training material
  • Support baseline due diligence projects by collecting, classifying and analyzing diverse data sets
  • Obtain and analyze / benchmark historical client real estate spend, square footage, and occupancy and lease data, comparing sites by region, location, square footage, and lease type or ownership status
  • Liaise with key stakeholders within JLL and client organizations to assist in data gathering, and support in getting approvals for each engagement
  • Work with the Commercial Delivery team to create and maintain a project plan and timeline; monitor and communicate status updates to key stakeholders through agreed-upon governance routines specific to each project
  • Organize meetings with various stakeholders (both internal and external)
  • Work across different business units to ensure data is thoroughly validated.
  • Identify in-scope services to categorize facility spend as controllable or non-controllable
  • Document and resolve open issues or next steps as rolling action items requiring quick decisions in a fast-paced environment
  • Gain and maintain a detailed understanding of various contracting and commercial models, service delivery options, and revenue opportunities for JLL accounts

Core Competencies

Commercial Acumen

  • Has operational understanding of the Work Dynamics business model, client requirements, industry delivery and contracting models
  • Understands facility management contracts. Knowledge of complex commercial contracts and the risks and obligations of service providers in delivering required outcomes is highly valued.
  • Ability to communicate commercial issues with internal stakeholders
  • Ability to identify red flags and contractual risks
  • Ability to understand baseline Due Diligence goals and report outcomes.

Critical Analysis

  • Ability to critically review and analyse complex financial and operational data sets so to identify potential inaccuracies, or gaps in information.
  • Knowledge of the costs and activities associated with Facilities Management for a diverse range of commercial real estate portfolios including office, industrial, manufacturing and retail environments.

Project Management

  • Demonstrate ability to meet critical deadlines and to work within project schedules.
  • Task oriented and able to keep track of multiple project timelines and coordinate with various workstreams.
  • Process oriented and able to utilize technology platforms to work effectively
  • Understanding of when and how to effectively escalate complications or unforeseen problems in due diligence projects.
  • Ability to manage and present vast amounts of complex data in a succinct and understandable fashion.

Teamwork

An enthusiastic and positive collaborator, able to work effectively as part of a distributed team globally and partner with colleagues across diverse functions.

Shares learnings from a broad and deep range of relevant situations.

Experience

  • Successful candidates are likely to have 5 years of relevant business experience and a track record of working successfully with multi-disciplinary teams in a matrixed business environment.
  • Current knowledge of Work Dynamics business models, clients and geos will be highly valuable.
  • Facilities Management or Property Management experience is advantageous
  • Demonstrated successes in data analysis, drawing conclusions, and improvement.
  • Strong organisational and time management skills
  • Bachelor s degree in Finance preferred

Location

On-site Bengaluru, KA

Scheduled Weekly Hours

40

title: Data Engineer
jobDescription:
Join Cisco's Commerce Intelligence Data Analytics team, a pivotal group delivering seamless intelligence, advanced analytics, and cutting-edge agentic experiences across our business operations. Our mission is to build a scalable, unified, and AI-ready data foundation that drives high-impact business decisions and automated actions. We achieve this by blending innovation, deep process knowledge, technical expertise, and a relentless focus on business impact, ultimately enhancing operational efficiency and data-driven decision-making at scale.

As a Data Engineer, you will be instrumental in shaping our data landscape. You'll dive deep into operational processes, explore diverse source systems, and analyze complex data platforms to connect critical commerce operational needs. Your expertise will drive the design, build, and maintenance of a robust data ecosystem, enabling advanced analytical capabilities, AI, and agentic solutions. You'll be responsible for end-to-end ETL/ELT pipeline development for both structured and unstructured data, ensuring data threading and transformation within our Golden layer working with the extended team US time zones. A key aspect of your role will be collaborating with business functions across various time zones to design and own a reusable semantic layer, powering consumption across AI, agentic solutions, dashboards, and various applications.

Responsibilities

  • Conduct in-depth exploratory data analysis to uncover trends and patterns in structured and unstructured datasets.
  • Translate complex business requirements into robust data solutions, integrating insights from diverse non-ERP sources with our Enterprise Data Warehouse (EDW).
  • Design, build, and optimize scalable ELT/ETL pipelines to ingest, transform, and publish data into the Snowflake Data Cloud.
  • Develop and maintain high-quality, analytics-ready data models using dbt, emphasizing modular design, reusability, rigorous testing, and maintainability.
  • Design and implement a reusable semantic layer that adheres to architectural standards and supports various consumption patterns (AI, agentic solutions, dashboards).
  • Leverage Snowflake Cortex to integrate AI/LLM capabilities directly into data pipelines, enabling advanced analytics.
  • Design and develop data consumption layers, including dashboards, reports, conversational analytics, and agentic solutions.
  • Champion and enforce data quality, observability, lineage, governance, and access control standards across our AI-ready data architecture.
  • Applies working knowledge of databases, relational databases, cloud services, and scripting languages
  • Contributes to data quality and compliance, including cleansing and scrubbing of data, data integrations and data quality framework
  • Collaborate strategically with data architects, analysts, and business stakeholders to define long-term data strategies and deliver scalable, reliable data solutions.
  • Establish and enforce technical governance, CI/CD best practices, and rigorous version control to ensure the integrity, security, and scalability of our modern data stack.
  • Demonstrated experience applying Agile, Scrum, or Kanban methodologies within a data engineering environment.
  • A self-starter with proven expertise to deliver outcomes with minimal supervision

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years of progressive experience in data engineering, with a proven track record in cloud data warehousing and modern data platform implementations.
  • 2+ years of hands-on experience developing AI and agentic solutions, specifically on platforms like Snowflake, AWS, or GCP.
  • Deep expertise with the Snowflake Data Cloud, encompassing its architecture, security model, and operational best practices.
  • Strong proficiency with dbt (Data Build Tool) for designing, developing, and maintaining data models, including automated testing and CI/CD integration.
  • Advanced SQL skills and practical working knowledge of Python for data manipulation and automation.
  • 5+ years of experience with leading BI/reporting tools such as Sigma or Power BI.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with data quality, observability, and lineage tools to enhance monitoring, validation, and governance across complex data pipelines.
  • Familiarity with advanced Snowflake capabilities (e.g., zero-copy cloning, secure data sharing, external tables, Snowpark, dynamic tables, MCP gateways).
  • Solid understanding of data and solution architecture principles.
  • Exposure to other BI/reporting tools (e.g., Tableau, ThoughtSpot) and a keen understanding of diverse downstream analytics consumption patterns.

descriptionFromApi:
Data AI/ML (Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning) Engineering involves the use of algorithms and statistical models to enable systems to analyze data, learn patterns, and make data-driven predictions or decisions without explicit human programming. AI/ML applications leverage vast amounts of data to identify insights, automate processes, and solve complex problems across a wide range of fields, including healthcare, finance, e-commerce, and more. AI/ML processes transform raw data into actionable intelligence, enabling automation, predictive analytics, and intelligent solutions. Data AI/ML combines advanced statistical modeling, computational power, and data engineering to build intelligent systems that can learn, adapt, and automate decisions.
A. P. Moller - Maersk

A. P. Moller - Maersk is the global leader in container shipping services. The business operates in 130 countries and employs 80, 000 staff. An integrated container logistics company, Maersk aims to connect and simplify its customers supply chains.

Today, we have more than 180 nationalities represented in our workforce across 131 Countries and this mean, we have elevated level of responsibility to continue to build inclusive workforce that is truly representative of our customers and their customers and our vendor partners too.
The team - who are we:
You will join a technical team of around 50 people in APM Terminals, building the systems behind some of the worlds leading container terminals - where the cranes move, the yard fills up, and the vessel is waiting.
What makes this work inspiring is how close it sits to the operation. Your models are not evaluated in isolation: they are discussed with the people who run the terminal and measured against what actually happens there. Getting that right is demanding, and it is what makes the results worth something.
Our backgrounds span operations research, simulation, machine learning, software engineering, and terminal operations themselves . Nobody here covers all of it, and that is deliberate - the most interesting problems tend to sit between two peoples expertise.
Your Impact
You will be part of the APM Terminals technical team. As an Applied Scientist, you will have a key role in designing, building, maintaining , and iterating on data-driven products that directly impact terminal operations. This position offers a unique opportunity to apply your technical knowledge to create operational and strategic insights that are transforming container terminal operations globally. This is an exciting time to join a growing and dynamic team that solves some of the toughest problems in terminal operations and builds the future of container shipping. We offer a unique opportunity to impact global trade via world-leading container terminals.
Key Responsibilities
  • Design, implement and deliver advanced solutions for terminal operations including container handling equipment efficiency, yard positioning strategies, vessel loading/unloading sequencing, and vehicle routing - contributing to system design, architecture, and solution design as new features take shape.
  • Build both operational tools for real-time, day-to-day terminal operations and strategic models for long-term planning and decision-making.
  • Act as the bridge between the physical yard and the code, translating messy, stochastic physical realities into logical mathematical models.
  • Explain complex model rationale and results to non-technical terminal operators and leadership to build trust and successfully roll out solutions to production environments.
  • Monitor model performance against actual physical terminal events, iteratively improving models to handle operational drift and increase effectiveness.
What You Bring (The T-Shaped Profile)
We are looking for hybrid problem-solvers . We do not expect you to know everything; rather, we want to see a solid technical foundation combined with real depth somewhere.
The Core Foundation (Required)
  • Experience : We typically look for 5+ years of industry experience building and delivering technical or optimization solutions. This is a guideline, not a filter - a strong PhD, or exceptional demonstrated ability, can substitute for part of it. We do expect some industry experience: you should have shipped something real that people depend on.
  • Education : M. Sc. or PhD in Operations Research, Industrial Engineering, Machine Learning, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field - or equivalent practical depth.
  • Production Python : Track record of delivering production-quality Python code for data-centric applications, specifically integrating models ( e. g. machine learning, optimization, simulation, or statistical logic) into functional software.
  • Systems-level problem solving : You can observe a physical operational bottleneck, frame it mathematically, and objectively decide the best analytical tool to solve it.
Your Area of Expertise
We are looking for depth, breadth, or a mix of the two. Either works:

You'll partner closely with clients, developers, business analysts, architects, and implementation teams translating business requirements into test strategy, flagging risk early, and making sure what ships is reliable and measurable.


Why Join Us?

You'll test and help shape some of the most advanced AI and Salesforce work being built today, working directly with clients and cross-functional teams in a fast-moving, highly collaborative environment. Key Responsibilities

Client-Facing Quality & Implementation

  • Lead testing engagements directly with enterprise clients UAT, validation workshops, solution walkthroughs.
  • Translate client business processes into clear, measurable quality criteria and test scenarios.
  • Partner with implementation consultants, BAs, developers, and architects to confirm solutions meet agreed requirements.
  • Guide non-technical stakeholders through UAT and explain findings in plain business language.
  • Flag implementation risk early and recommend fixes before they become client-facing problems.

AI & Agentic Workflow Testing

  • Validate AI-driven solutions Agentforce agents, AI recruiting workflows, digital workers, and LLM-powered applications.
  • Test prompt performance, conversational logic, factual accuracy, context handling, edge cases, guardrails, and AI-to-human handoffs.
  • Stress-test AI behavior across positive, negative, ambiguous, and adversarial scenarios.
  • Catch hallucinations, inconsistent responses, and failure patterns, and work with engineering to close them.
  • Build and maintain AI evaluation datasets and regression scenarios to hold performance steady across releases.

Salesforce & Functional Testing

  • Run functional, regression, system, and end-to-end testing across Salesforce implementations.
  • Test Lightning Experience, Flows, Apex-driven functionality, custom components, and Salesforce Industries/OmniStudio where applicable.
  • Validate business processes across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and other Salesforce products.
  • Confirm data integrity and that system behavior matches business requirements.
  • Build test scenarios covering standard workflows, edge cases, and business-critical processes.

Integration & API Testing

  • Test integrations between Salesforce and third-party apps, middleware, APIs, and external systems.
  • Run REST/SOAP API testing and validate data flow between connected systems.
  • Use Postman or similar tools for API validation.
  • Validate data mapping, transformation, and error/failure handling across integrations.

Outcome-Based Test Strategy

  • Design and execute manual and automated test plans anchored to real business outcomes.
  • Build risk-based testing strategies that prioritize critical processes and customer impact.
  • Create reusable test scenarios and regression suites that scale with implementation and deployment.
  • Push testing beyond functional correctness into reliability, usability, adoption, and business impact.

Proactive Problem Solving

  • Investigate defects, bottlenecks, data issues, and logic failures down to root cause.
  • Work with developers, BAs, architects, and implementation teams on solutions not just defect logs.
  • Spot failure points before they hit clients.
  • Support troubleshooting and resolution of production issues when needed.

Defect & Lifecycle Management

  • Track and prioritize defects in JIRA or equivalent tools.
  • Document defects with clear repro steps, expected vs. actual results, severity, business impact, and evidence.
  • Drive defects through resolution with development teams, on timeline.
  • Verify fixes and run regression testing after resolution.

Continuous QA Improvement & Automation

  • Build and evolve QA standards, processes, templates, and best practices.
  • Identify what's worth automating repetitive, high-value test scenarios.
  • Build and maintain automated regression suites (Selenium, Playwright, Provar, or similar).
  • Improve QA efficiency through reusable test assets, automation, and CI/CD integration.

Qualifications & Requirements

Required

  • 3–5+ years in software QA, with hands-on Salesforce platform/implementation testing.
  • Experience testing Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Salesforce Industries, OmniStudio, or similar.
  • Strong functional, regression, integration, system, end-to-end, and UAT testing experience.
  • Strong client-facing communication skills — comfortable running UAT and validation with business stakeholders.
  • Familiarity with AI/LLM applications, conversational AI, prompt testing, or AI-powered workflows; direct Agentforce experience is a strong plus.
  • A problem-solving mindset — able to break down complex processes, spot edge cases, and drive root-cause fixes.
  • Experience with JIRA or similar defect-tracking and test management tools.
  • Working knowledge of API and third-party integration testing, ideally with Postman.
  • Ability to communicate technical findings and risk clearly to both technical and business audiences.

Preferred

  • Direct experience testing Agentforce, digital workers, or generative AI solutions within Salesforce.
  • Experience with AI evaluation, prompt testing, conversational AI, or AI QA.
  • Automation experience with Selenium, Playwright, Provar, or similar frameworks.
  • Experience with Salesforce Flow, Apex, LWC/custom components, or OmniStudio.
  • REST/SOAP API and integration testing experience.
  • Familiarity with data validation and basic SQL.
  • Salesforce certifications (Administrator, AI Associate, or similar).
  • ISTQB Foundation or Advanced Level certification (Test Analyst or AI Testing track).
  • Working knowledge of Agile/Scrum and CI/CD deployment pipelines.
  • Experience with enterprise Salesforce implementations and complex integration environments.

What Success Looks Like

  • Salesforce implementations ship with high quality and minimal production defects.
  • AI-powered workflows perform reliably, accurately, and consistently.
  • Clients trust the testing process and complete UAT with confidence.
  • Critical business and edge-case scenarios surface before deployment, not after.
  • QA processes get more automated, scalable, and efficient over time.
  • Testing translates directly into successful implementation, adoption, and measurable client outcomes.

  • Database Testing: Validate database records, data integrity, data flow, and backend processes using SQL and relational databases.
  • End-to-End Testing: Validate complete business workflows across applications, APIs, databases, and integrated systems.
  • CI/CD Integration: Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines and support continuous testing practices.
  • Quality Risk Management: Perform risk-based testing, identify potential quality risks, and recommend appropriate testing strategies and mitigation approaches.
  • Performance Optimization: Analyze test execution and automation results, troubleshoot failures, and continuously improve test coverage and execution efficiency.
  • Agile Collaboration: Participate in Agile ceremonies including Sprint Planning, Daily Standups, Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives.
  • Release Validation: Support release and deployment validation activities and ensure software meets defined quality standards before production release.
  • Quality Improvement: Contribute to continuous improvement of QA processes, standards, tools, frameworks, and best practices.
  • Technical Contribution: Participate in code reviews, test strategy discussions, technical discussions, and automation roadmap planning.
  • Mentoring: Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior QA engineers and contribute to building overall team capabilities.


Required Skills & Qualifications
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.

  • Hands-on experience with one or more automation tools such as:
    • Selenium WebDriver
    • Cypress
    • Playwright (Preferred)
    • TestNG / JUnit
    • Cucumber / BDD
    • Appium
  • Proficiency in at least one programming/scripting language such as Java, Python, or JavaScript .
  • Strong knowledge of SQL and database testing.
  • Hands-on experience with API testing using Postman, REST Assured, SOAP UI, or Swagger/OpenAPI .
  • Experience working with CI/CD and DevOps tools such as Jenkins, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Git, Maven, or Gradle .
  • Experience with defect tracking and test management tools such as JIRA, TestRail, HP ALM/Quality Center, or Azure DevOps .
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments .
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and troubleshooting skills.
  • Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in a team environment.


Preferred Skills
  • Hands-on experience with Playwright and modern automation frameworks.
  • Experience developing and maintaining scalable automation frameworks.
  • Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP .
  • Experience with performance testing tools such as JMeter or LoadRunner .
  • Experience testing Microservices Architecture .
  • Strong knowledge of API automation frameworks.
  • Understanding of Security and Accessibility Testing .
  • Experience with healthcare domain applications, including HIPAA, HL7, EHR/EMR, Claims, Eligibility, or Revenue Cycle .
  • Experience with FHIR-based integrations .
  • Exposure to MCP and AI-assisted workflow testing .
  • Familiarity with modern CI/CD and continuous testing practices.
  • Experience with test automation reporting, monitoring, and quality metrics.

The Business Analyst IV serves as a business analysis leader responsible for shaping business strategy, guiding enterprise initiatives, and driving alignment between organizational objectives and technology-enabled solutions. Acting as a trusted advisor and subject matter expert, the Business Analyst IV provides strategic oversight across multiple programs, drives cross-functional and cross-domain alignment, establishes business analysis standards and best practices, and leads complex transformation initiatives that deliver measurable business outcomes. The role also champions innovation, advances organizational business analysis capability, and mentors analysts across all levels.

Essential Functions:
  • Establish and maintain executive-level partnerships across business and technology functions, driving strategic alignment, informed decision-making, and accountability for enterprise initiatives
  • Partner with senior leadership to evaluate investment opportunities, develop business cases, define success measures, and ensure realization of intended business outcomes
  • Own business analysis strategy and execution across multiple programs, portfolios, and enterprise initiatives, ensuring alignment with organizational objectives and value realization goals
  • Provide strategic oversight for Epics, Features, and related requirements artifacts throughout their lifecycle, ensuring alignment with enterprise priorities, funding commitments, delivery objectives, and measurable business outcomes
  • Lead complex requirements discovery, analysis, facilitation, and modeling efforts across multiple business domains, shaping scalable solutions for enterprise-wide challenges
  • Advise leadership on initiative prioritization, funding decisions, resource allocation, business value measurement, and portfolio tradeoffs
  • Review and provide guidance on business cases, contracts, architectural artifacts, and program deliverables to ensure alignment with strategic objectives, operational goals, and compliance requirements
  • Analyze operational, financial, and business performance data to identify trends, risks, opportunities, and recommendations that support enterprise decision-making and continuous improvement
  • Establish strategic estimates, funding assumptions, business value metrics, and outcome measures for large-scale initiatives, change requests, and investment decisions
  • Identify, assess, and proactively manage enterprise-level risks, dependencies, issues, and decision points impacting program and portfolio success
  • Provide executive-level reporting, insights, and recommendations regarding business outcomes, delivery performance, risks, dependencies, and strategic objectives
  • Guide business and technology leaders in evaluating business impacts, solution alternatives, tradeoffs, and organizational change implications
  • Lead the adoption of AI-enabled tools, advanced analytics, automation capabilities, and emerging technologies to modernize business analysis practices, improve decision-making, and accelerate business value realization
  • Establish, govern, and continuously improve business analysis methodologies, standards, tools, templates, and best practices across the organization
  • Lead and support enterprise transformation initiatives, organizational change efforts, mergers and acquisitions, and strategic modernization programs
  • Provide leadership, coaching, and mentorship to Business Analysts, Business Operations professionals, and project teams, fostering organizational capability, knowledge sharing, and professional growth
  • Prepare and present strategic recommendations, business insights, and program outcomes to executive leadership and key stakeholders.
  • Perform any other job related duties as requested.

  • Expert knowledge of business analysis methodologies, requirements management practices, SDLCs, and enterprise delivery frameworks
  • Exceptional strategic thinking, systems analysis, problem-solving, and decision-making skills
  • Executive-level communication, facilitation, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills
  • Demonstrated ability to lead multiple cross-functional teams, programs, and enterprise initiatives
  • Expertise in business case development, investment analysis, ROI evaluation, and value realization
  • Advanced knowledge of healthcare payer operations, regulatory requirements, and compliance standards
  • Ability to establish standards, governance processes, and organizational best practices
  • Experience leveraging AI-enabled tools, advanced analytics, and automation technologies to drive enterprise decision-making and business transformation
  • Ability to analyze and interpret complex operational, financial, and performance data to support strategic planning and organizational outcomes
  • Experience supporting large-scale transformation, mergers and acquisitions, or organizational integration initiatives
Licensure and Certification:
  • IIBA, Six Sigma, ITIL, and/or Agile, Lean, SAFe Certifications preferred

  • General office environment; may be required to sit or stand for extended periods of time
  • Travel is not typically required

About the Role
As Senior Executive - L&D at redBus, you will drive skill development for employees across tech and non-tech teams. You will identify skill gaps, design and deliver learning interventions to close them, and own the end-to-end process from finding and onboarding the right trainers and vendors to curating and delivering content in-house. You will have cross-functional exposure to identify and meet learning needs across the organization. Your work will ensure our people have the competencies they need to meet redBus's business goals, and that learning is embedded into how teams operate every day.
Key Responsibilities
Skills & Competency Framework
Own and maintain the skills and competency framework, keeping it current as roles and business needs evolve.
Champion awareness of competencies and learning charters, and help individuals and teams use the framework to plan their development.
Drive the rollout and adoption of learning frameworks across teams.

Learning Design & Delivery
Assess skill gaps across functions and design targeted interventions - external training, internal programs, and blended or digital formats to address them.
Curate and maintain an L&D calendar for the Financial Year and ensure budget computations are in place.
Organize and conduct training and awareness sessions, researching and delivering content in-house where appropriate.
Curate and maintain a library of relevant learning content and resources, with a focus on tech and product teams.
Publish monthly and quarterly L&D reports for audit and visibility purposes.
Experiment with new formats and approaches to keep learning interventions impactful as business needs evolve. Show creativity and proactiveness in improving L&D initiatives and delivery, not just limited to theory but practical takeaways.
Capture feedback and monitor employee engagement during L&D interventions.

Vendor & Trainer Management
Identify, evaluate, negotiate and onboard external vendors and trainers.
Ensuring business relevance and alignment with external vendors.
Manage ongoing vendor relationships, including quality, scheduling, and cost-effectiveness.
Ensuring adherence to organizational compliance while managing vendors.

Stakeholder Engagement
Partner with team managers and HRBPs to integrate training plans into team activities and ensure adoption.
Develop communication and engagement strategies that build visibility and enthusiasm for learning initiatives.
Collaborate with the Admin to ensure logistics are arranged for the trainings and events accordingly.
Update relevant stakeholders on the success metrics of L&D initiatives, training impact, engagement levels and forward-looking improvements through timely sharing of the feedback report.

Measurement & Improvement
Use data, dashboards, and analytics to track learning participation, progress, and outcomes.
Refine programs and the competency framework based on what the data shows.
Publish training summaries and way forward for the respective training conducted.

What You'll Bring
Required
23 years of L&D experience, with a Master's degree in HR.
Hands-on experience managing or implementing competency frameworks.
Experience designing learning initiatives and interventions with measurable impact.
Strong stakeholder management skills; comfortable engaging people across functional, technical, and operational areas.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Comfort with data: Good with collecting, analyzing and representing data. Able to use dashboards and analytics to measure and improve learning outcomes.
Experience managing vendor and trainer relationships.
Familiarity with digital learning tools and platforms (LMS, e-learning content, virtual delivery).
Comfort with widely-used AI tools in the HR domain.

Preferred
Experience in a product-based or high-growth technology organization.
Exposure to designing learning for technical and non technical audiences.
Who Thrives Here
You're adaptable and energized by a fast-paced environment. You are unafraid to take charge, can approach stakeholders confidently and are high on accountability. You understand the business context behind L&D how learning connects to broader organizational goals and you model continuous learning yourself.

jobDescription:

As a Lead Software Engineer at JPMorganChase within the Commercial Investment Bank Payments Technology team, you are an integral part of an agile team that works to enhance, build, and deliver trusted market-leading technology products in a secure, stable, and scalable way. As a core technical contributor, you are responsible for conducting critical technology solutions across multiple technical areas within various business functions in support of the firm s business objectives.

Job responsibilities
  • Executes creative software solutions, design, development, and technical troubleshooting with ability to think beyond routine or conventional approaches to build solutions or breakdown technical problems
  • Develops secure and high-quality production code, and reviews and debugs code written by others
